integrity: Theorem and strict feasibility criterion are proved analytically. Numerical maximization and reconstruction are supplementary finite checks. Priority against the inaccessible full 1990 source text remains a declared uncertainty.
limitations: Proved only for two horizontal finite equal-depth inviscid incompressible layers between rigid walls, known densities and gravity, positive interfacial tension, and exact normal-mode peak observations. Deep-layer inverse is exponentially ill-conditioned. No experimental noise theorem, unequal-depth theorem, nonlinear theorem, or complete historical-priority guarantee.
title: Sharp peak-growth tomography for two equal-depth Rayleigh–Taylor layers
